bosc:provenance.subject: Former Sylvania / GTE / Philips Display Components (LG.Philips Displays USA) CRT plant campus, 700-804 N Pratt St, Village of Ottawa, Putnam County OH (FIPS 39137) — the two contiguous industrial parcels the campus was subdivided into and sold as in 2006, out of the LG.Philips Displays USA Chapter 11. 38.234 ac deeded / 38.293 ac planar. #1420, sub-issue of #1269.
bosc:provenance.source: Putnam County GIS — ArcGIS REST, Parcels/Parcels MapServer layer 0 (auditor CAMA + geometry), read through the putnam_gis connector (PUTNAM_PARCEL_SCHEMA, #420)
caveats: [verified] Owner of record, deeded acreage, land-use code, the auditor's land and building appraised values, half-year tax, legal description, inlot number and the conveyance date/amount/type are verbatim from the Putnam County Auditor CAMA on the county's Parcels layer 0 (read 2026-07-31); null means the service had no value. auditor_url is derived as https://auditor.putnamcountyohio.gov/Parcel?Parcel=<PIN> and asserted equal to the layer's own PARCELURL column on both parcels — it is the layer's citation, not a constructed one. The auditor's web page itself was NOT re-read: it returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so every figure here rests on the county GIS.

THE CAMPUS IS THESE TWO PARCELS AND THEY ARE CONTIGUOUS. Their union is a single polygon — the shared-boundary distance is 0.0 m and the union area (38.29338 ac) equals the sum of the parts (38.29338 ac) to 5 decimal places, so they abut without overlapping. Extent is 244 m E-W by 803 m N-S. Both are auditor use code 350 (industrial/manufacturing) and both were conveyed by WARRANTY DEED in 2006, the year the campus was broken up: IL 1544 (804 N Pratt, 15.392 ac) on 2006-07-11 for $350,000 and IL 1540 (700 N Pratt, 22.842 ac) on 2006-12-21 for $500,000.

INLOTS 1541, 1542 AND 1543 ARE NOT PART OF THIS CAMPUS AND ARE DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED. The #1420 issue text lists them as though they were the remainder of the subdivided campus in third-party hands. They are not adjacent to it at all: measured in UTM 16N from the campus boundary, IL 1543 (Trinity United Methodist Church) is 206.95 m away, IL 1542 is 559.72 m and IL 1541 (Ormsby trust) is 1,090.26 m. None is industrial-class (510 / 420 / 510 against the campus's 350) and none has a Pratt St situs. Putnam's inlot numbers are issued in platting order, not in geographic order, so an adjacent inlot number is not evidence of adjacent ground — that is the error the issue's table inherited, and it is recorded here rather than silently corrected.

THE ADJACENT INDUSTRIAL PARCEL IS ALSO EXCLUDED, AND IT IS A LEAD. IL 1536 (32-218000.0000, 615 N Agner St, 16.47 ac, use code 350) sits 20.13 m from the campus — 66.0 ft, i.e. one platted street right-of-way, so it is directly across the street, not part of it. AGNER ROAD INVESTMENTS LLC (mailing PO Box 810, Royal Oak MI) bought it on 2022-07-07 together with IL 1548 and IL 1549 for a single recorded $3,950,000 repeated on all three rows. Whether that ground was ever part of the Sylvania/Philips works is [open] — no deed, plat or site plan in the corpus settles it — so it is a lead, not a member of the assemblage.

acres is the auditor's DEEDED figure (38.234 ac total); planar_acres is measured from this geometry in UTM 16N (EPSG:32616), the site's hydro_utm_epsg (38.293 ac total). The +0.059-ac (0.15%) spread is the deed-vs-GIS difference and is NOT reconciled — cite the deeded figure for the record and the planar one for area/runoff modelling.

appraised_total_value is null on every feature BY CONSTRUCTION, not by absence: this layer publishes no combined-total column, and the land and building values are never summed here. The sibling Parcels/ParcelsJoined service does publish PPTotalVal, PPLandValu, PPImprValu, PPOnCauv and a ValidSale flag — but all five read null for these parcels, so re-pointing at it would not recover them.

THE COUNTY PUBLISHES TWO DIFFERENT IMPROVEMENT VALUES FOR 804 N PRATT, AND THE LEVIED TAX SETTLES WHICH ONE IS LIVE. A third county layer, Land_Features/LandUseParcels (the CAMA join carrying PPTotalVal), gives 322260000000 an improvement value of $510,700 for a $729,240 total, against the $131,457 / $350,000 on the wired Parcels layer 0 committed here. The half-year tax decides it: layer 0's totals divide into the levied HALFTAX at an effective 0.0065988 on 322220000000 and 0.0065989 on 322260000000 — the same millage to seven figures — whereas the LandUseParcels total for 322260000000 gives 0.0031671, about half. The two layers AGREE exactly on 322220000000 ($609,429 vs $609,430, a rounding difference), so this is a single-parcel discrepancy, not a systematic difference between the services. The committed values are therefore layer 0's, and they are the ones the tax bill is computed on. Note also that 322260000000's land + building sum to EXACTLY its 2006 sale price of $350,000, which is worth a second look whenever the roll is re-pulled; no conclusion is drawn from it here.

SOIL CORROBORATION FROM THE COUNTY'S OWN LAYER, and it is independent of SSURGO. LandUseParcels carries a per-parcel SOIL_TYPE split by area, and it names exactly the map units the SSURGO grid returned: over the 38.257 ac it accounts for, Urban land 22.075 ac (57.7%), Toledo 6.611, Fulton A 3.887, Fulton B 3.591, Lucas C2 2.035 and Dl A 0.059. Against SSURGO's 61% of grid points unrated as Urban land that is a ~3-point agreement between an area measure and a point sample. The per-parcel asymmetry is the part that matters and the grid could not show it: 700 N Pratt — the remediation property — is 91.4% Urban land, while 804 N Pratt is only 7.7%. The one map unit SSURGO's grid missed entirely is Dl A at 0.059 ac (0.4%), too small for a 59-point lattice to land on.

THE WIRED LAYER LAGS ITS OWN SIBLING ON OWNERSHIP. Parcels/ParcelsJoined carries conveyances that Parcels layer 0 has not picked up — 237 N Pratt St stands as HEEBSH (2021-06-30) on layer 0 and as FAWCETT/AVERESCH with a 2026-06-02 sale on ParcelsJoined, and IL 1542 stands as MELISA WAY LLC on layer 0 and MEYER PROPERTIES LLC on ParcelsJoined. For BOTH campus parcels the two layers AGREE (OTTAWA OH LLC and VERHOFF PROPERTIES LLC), so the record committed here is corroborated across both services and is not affected. ParcelsJoined is not the wired source because it is thinner where it matters — no values, no sale date/amount, acreage rounded to 2 dp — and it keys on a different id column (Parcel2 dashless / Parcel dashed), which is why a PIN-shaped query against its `Parcel` field returns zero rows rather than an error. Re-checking the two owners against ParcelsJoined on each re-pull is the standing follow-up.

THE GRANTOR AND THE DEED ARE [open]. This layer carries no grantor, no deed book/page and no instrument number, so the Sylvania (1947) -> GTE -> Philips (1981) -> LG.Philips Displays USA (2001) -> 2006 Chapter 11 -> OTTAWA OH LLC / VERHOFF PROPERTIES LLC chain is NOT closed by this dataset. The 2006 dates and warranty-deed type are consistent with the bankruptcy disposition and no more than that; the Putnam County Recorder instruments are the pull (#1421). The identity of OTTAWA OH LLC (auditor mailing c/o APTM INC, 6975 Long Beach Blvd, Long Beach CA) is likewise [open].

OWNERSHIP IS NOT THE BROWNFIELD GRANTEE. The three Ohio Brownfield Remediation Program awards over this campus ($4,571,596 total) were made to the Port Authority of Northwestern Ohio (Rounds 1 and 11) and the Putnam County Land Reutilization Corp (Round 5) — neither of which is the owner of record on either parcel. That is recorded as it stands; reading it as an acquisition, an option or a receivership would be [inference] and none is supported here (#1421).

The campus is a FORMER industrial works, not a proposed or disclosed data-center site. Ottawa's SiteProfile carries facilities=() and no data-center facility is disclosed anywhere in this site's record. This geometry is committed as the site's anchor PLACE — it must not be read as a campus siting.

Field names and semantics confirmed from the live layer-0 metadata and samples (2026-06-21, re-confirmed 2026-07-31). The layer's District and Class columns are UNRELIABLE: both read 0 on the two campus parcels while the neighbouring IL 1536 reads District 32 / Class 3, so a `District = 32` filter silently DROPS the campus. Filter on PIN or on the populated CLASS_1 column instead — never on District or Class.
